# The Charter Program

We built the Growth Engine for exterior contractors, where it has generated **millions in project revenue and thousands of qualified estimates**. Our first client grew his revenue 4x in his first seven months on the system.

::: green | PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE
We will generate your first **three qualified in-home consultations that successfully sit** within 10 days — before you pay us anything beyond your deposit.

- Consultations must meet the agreed qualification criteria.
- Homeowner no-shows do not count toward the three — tell us within 48 hours and we rebook the replacement at our cost.

^ HOW BILLING WORKS
# After Your First Payment

First payment :: $1,500, due within three business days of your third sat consultation ($1,300 after your deposit is credited)
Ongoing :: $1,500 per month for as long as the Engine is running for you
Billing anchor :: Monthly service periods run from your Launch Date — your second month begins 30 days after your Engine goes live, then monthly from there
No installation fee :: Charter Partners pay no separate setup or onboarding charge
